seal.statement: An authoritative service-lifecycle reconciliation of the system-table cache never installs a services row that claims a version newer than the columns it carries: when the authoritative row read from the services partition is newer than the cached row, the cached row afterwards holds the authoritative value of every column the authoritative row carries, including raft_role; an absent (null or missing) cached value never overrides an authoritative value; and the refresh reports the cache aligned only when the cached row agrees with the authoritative row on every authoritative column, or the cached row is strictly newer.

text: Transition record and scope before any edit (base 9a22bf79b, rule-set revision 5). Cause traced read-only on ed708dfd and reproduced deterministically; analysis retained at lagrange-foundation-coordination-20261114/partial-row-cache-write-analysis.md. 1 Producer/consumer: trigger confirmActiveReplicaTerminalHandoff (src/rebalancer operation-workflow-recovery-status-reconcile) -> refreshAuthoritativeReplicaCacheRow -> refreshAuthoritativeCacheRow (cdc-integration-service-cache-visibility-wait: SELECT * full row, lifecycle mode forced for services) -> applyAuthoritativeCacheRepairRow -> applySystemTableChange (mutation mode authoritative_service_lifecycle_reconciliation, which skips isStaleForExistingRecord and always reports incomingVersionAccepted) -> buildAuthoritativeServiceLifecycleCacheReplacement (src/cache/system-table-cache-authoritative-reconciliation.js): starts from the cached row, copies authoritative fields only where the cached row lacks the key, overlays lifecycle fields when the authoritative durable version is >= the cached one, labels updated_at = max, then applyPreservedNonLeaderVoterRaftRole. Consumers: about 25 readers of raft_role (remove-safety, budget, move/surplus planning, learner promotion, readiness surplus, CAS guards, priority-spread projection) and areAuthoritativeSystemTableCacheRowsAligned, whose true answer lets the handoff complete. 2 Shape: the services row as read from the services partition; no new type. 3 Identity/generation: row key (service id); durable version column resolved by resolveServiceDurableVersion; updated_at is the cache's version label; updated_at_hlc exists only on CDC-delivered rows and is legitimately dropped when superseded. 4 Ordering: authority newer than cache => authority's columns; cache strictly newer => cache row kept (existing contract); equal version => every authoritative column must agree for aligned, and absent cached content never wins. 5 Absent vs unavailable: a null/missing cached column is absent evidence, never newer evidence; an unreadable authority stays the existing typed refusal. 6 Durable commit: none changes; the cache is a projection. 7 Retained obligations: none; a later CDC event for the same row still applies under the ordinary version fence. 8 Wake/cleanup: unchanged. Writable paths: src/cache/system-table-cache-authoritative-reconciliation.js, src/cache/system-table-cache.js only where this mode's apply consumes the builder, test/cache/system-table-cache-services-lifecycle-merge.test.js, test/rebalancer/operation-workflow-active-cache-handoff.test.js and one new real-consumer witness. Excluded: every consumer of raft_role, CDC delivery, HLC stamping, bounds, journey predicates. History to respect: CL-021 (701db25fa), CL-035/CL-016, quest executor-active-services-cache-handoff ('preserve newer evidence'); merge body present since 3bf3f2406; the wip/formation-integration line has a byte-identical builder and no repair. Wider question recorded for the epic, not absorbed here: whether any cache row may be ahead of durable authority at all (owner rule 2026-11-02: the cache never grants).

SUPERSESSION RECORD (R09), 2026-11-14, by the lead after the candidate 3bd5053b5 and the writer's three documented interleavings. The sealed text is not edited; where this record differs it governs and the verifier is briefed with it. S-1 refines 'a version newer than the columns it carries': a services row has two version dimensions and each column group is judged by its own: the lifecycle fields (SYSTEM_TABLE_CACHE_SERVICE_LIFECYCLE_FIELD_NAMES) by the durable lifecycle version resolveServiceDurableVersion yields (state_entered_at within one incarnation), every other column including raft_role by updated_at. A newer cached lifecycle group may therefore sit under an authority-newer updated_at (matching mergeRecords); that is not a mislabel. S-2 supersedes the statement clause 'aligned only when the cached row agrees with the authoritative row on every authoritative column, or the cached row is strictly newer' for exactly one interleaving: equal updated_at, both rows holding a non-null but different raft_role, no source position on the authoritative read. Neither side is provably newer without a source position (the read carries an applied index, the cached row may carry a CDC source log index; no gate compares them today), and the existing witnessed contract (CL-021, CL-035/CL-016, quest executor-active-services-cache-handoff, test '...same-version role event carrying newer origin HLC', applyPreservedNonLeaderVoterRaftRole) keeps the cached voter role and reports aligned. That behaviour is unchanged by this quest, is pinned by a test that documents it, and is routed as a finding to the cache position contract (a later unit); it is the case the constraint preserve-proven-newer-local-evidence told the writer to report rather than resolve. S-3 an authoritative null or missing column carries no evidence and never overrides a cached value; a cached null or missing column never survives when the authoritative row carries a value at an equal or newer version of that column's group. Frozen claim for verification: P1 after the reconciliation no column older than the authoritative value survives under a group version label at or above the authority's, except the S-2 tie; P2 absent cached content never survives against authoritative content at an equal or newer group version; P3 a strictly newer cached group is never regressed; P4 aligned is never reported while the cached row is older in a group or holds absent content where the authority holds a value, and is reported when the rows agree, the cached group is strictly newer, or the S-2 tie holds; P5 through the production entrypoint (terminal handoff refresh) the real reader (priority-spread projection) sees the replica with its authoritative raft_role and the handoff does not complete against a row that fails P1 or P2. Findings routed, not absorbed (R17): the S-2 tie; a strictly newer cached row filled for a missing key from the older read; cdc_merge keeping a superseded updated_at_hlc when the incoming row has none; the stale backfill placing older null-fill columns under the newer label; seedLocalPriorityServiceRow synthesising partial rows.

REJECT of candidate 3bd5053b5. Introduced regressions (green on base, red on candidate; probe jobs 310d0eed adams-gamla and 3da8f88c tv-dator): B1 with the authority row newer and an authoritative column null or missing, the cached value is wiped (raft_role, group_id); through the production handoff a CL-035 local voter seed (cached active/follower under an older label by design) against authority active/null at a newer version completes with raft_role null and the projection loses the holder, where the base keeps it. B2 at equal updated_at with a strictly newer cached lifecycle group, a cached lifecycle column that is null is filled from the older authority (error_message, trigger_reason), an older value under a newer lifecycle label. By the claim's letter and pre-existing: B3 identity columns of a strictly newer cached row overwritten from the older read, an older cleanup row replacing a strictly newer cached one, no incarnation check when the cached row is kept; B4 the aligned predicate treats any present-but-different non-lifecycle column at equal version as aligned, not one interleaving. Model gaps: authoritative per-column state, cached content ahead of durable under an older label (owner-local seeds), caller. The measured interleaving itself passes; tests only gained lines; the witness is real end to end. Mutation table not run (reject fast).
